findings.message: SEMANTICS B1 / 'data-informed' mistranslated as 'مطلق'. EN: 'A data-informed decision runs the loop...' (docs/semester-1/gqur-300/unit-06/topic-03.mdx:43), Summary 'A data-informed decision runs question, evidence, options, trade-offs' (docs/.../topic-03.mdx:101), assessment description 'data-informed decisions' (docs/.../unit-assessment.mdx:3) and Unit summary (docs/.../unit-assessment.mdx:29). UR: 'معطیات سے مطلق فیصلہ' at i18n/ur/.../unit-06/topic-03.mdx:42 and :97, and 'معطیات سے مطلق فیصلوں/فیصلہ' at i18n/ur/.../unit-06/unit-assessment.mdx:3 and :27. 'مطلق' means 'absolute/purely'; as written the phrase reads 'a decision made purely by data', the exact misconception the unit corrects. Almost certainly a typo for 'مطلع' (informed). Repair: 'معطیات سے مطلع فیصلہ' or 'معطیات کی روشنی میں فیصلہ' at all four sites.

SEMANTICS B2 / 'gap' rendered as 'فرح' (joy). EN: 'literacy (10 years and above) at 57.54 percent, with its 14-point male-female gap' (docs/.../topic-03.mdx:64). UR: 'اپنے 14 نقطے والے مرد-خواتین فرح کے ساتھ' (i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:62). 'فرح' means joy; the intended word is 'فرق' (difference/gap). The verified statistic's framing noun is corrupted. Repair: 'مرد-خواتین فرق'.

SEMANTICS B3 / 'reconstruction' rendered as 'تعذیر' (punishment). EN: 'whether your reconstruction is fair' (docs/.../topic-03.mdx:121); 'one decision from your practicum reconstruction (Topic 6.3)' (docs/.../unit-assessment.mdx:142); 'the practicum decision reconstruction' (docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:65) and 'decision reconstruction' (docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:79). UR: 'آپ کی تعذیر منصفانہ ہے' (i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:114), 'اپنے پریکٹیکم تعذیر' (i18n/ur/.../unit-assessment.mdx:135), 'پریکٹیکم فیصلے کی تعذیر' (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:63) and 'فیصلے کی تعذیر' (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:76). 'تعذیر' means punishment/torment; the intended word is 'تعمیر' (construction). Repair: 'دوبارہ تعمیر' or 'تشکیل نو' at all four sites.

TERMINOLOGY B4 / 'denominator' rendered as 'ہرج'. EN: 'the convenient base hides the denominator' (docs/.../topic-02.mdx:100). UR: 'آسان بنیاد ہرج (denominator) چھپاتی ہے' (i18n/ur/.../topic-02.mdx:93). 'ہرج' is not the Urdu mathematical term (it means confusion/pandemonium in general usage); the course's own Unit 2 and the site glossary use 'نسبت نما' (i18n/ur/.../gqur-300/unit-02/topic-01.mdx:62 'نچلا عدد (نسب نما)'; glossary.json Fraction definition). The English gloss in parentheses mitigates but does not fix the drift. Repair: 'آسان بنیاد نسبت نما چھپاتی ہے'.

TERMINOLOGY B5 / residual 'خود جانچ' outside the banked pair. EN: 'the Unit 1 self-assessment re-read' (docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:80). UR: 'یونٹ 1 کی خود جانچ کی دوبارہ پڑھائی' (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:76). The bank (specs/content/terminology.csv:102) accepts 'خود جائزہ / خود تشخیصی', and the rest of this unit correctly uses 'خود جائزہ' (index.mdx:68, topic-03.mdx:105, unit-assessment.mdx:135). This is a residual instance of the course-wide sweep defect class, not a new class. Repair: 'خود جائزہ'.

SEMANTICS B6 / 'cohort' rendered as 'کورٹ' (court). EN: 'they are the course's own evidence, and the next cohort's first reading' (docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:82). UR: 'اور اگلی کورٹ کا پہلا مطالعہ' (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:78). 'کورٹ' is 'court'; the intended meaning is the next group of trainees. Repair: 'اگلے طلبہ کے گروہ' or 'اگلی بیچ'.

REGISTER A1 / typo cluster (one-word, meaning recoverable but non-standard): 'لوک' for 'لوگ' (people) at i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:70 vs docs/.../topic-03.mdx:73; 'رقمت' for 'رقم' (amount) at i18n/ur/.../topic-01.mdx:112 and unit-assessment.mdx:102,161 vs docs/.../topic-01.mdx:122, unit-assessment.mdx:106,169; 'اس ضلے' for 'اس ضلع' (district) at i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:121 and unit-assessment.mdx:127 vs docs/.../topic-03.mdx:127, unit-assessment.mdx:134; spelling variant 'اساتذے' for 'اساتذہ' (teachers) at i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:129-130 and unit-assessment.mdx:189 while the same files use 'اساتذہ' elsewhere.

TERMINOLOGY A2 / 'canteen' transliterated two ways in the same unit: 'کینٹین' at i18n/ur/.../unit-06/index.mdx:66 vs 'کینٹن' at topic-01.mdx:134, topic-02.mdx:111, unit-assessment.mdx:122,131,192 and unit-teacher-notes.mdx:63 (EN 'canteen' throughout). 'کینٹن' reads as 'canton/cantonment'. Propose standardising on 'کینٹین' and banking it; the reviewer has not edited the bank.

SEMANTICS A3 / emphatic 'never' dropped in two of three renderings of the unit's closing claim. EN: 'numbers inform decisions; they never replace the decider' (docs/.../index.mdx:25-26) and 'data informs the decision, never replaces the decider' (docs/.../unit-assessment.mdx:31-32). UR: 'وہ فیصلہ کرنے والے کی جگہ نہیں لیتے' (i18n/ur/.../index.mdx:35-36) and 'فیصلہ کن کی جگہ نہیں لیتے' (i18n/ur/.../unit-assessment.mdx:30) drop 'کبھی', while i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:101 correctly keeps it ('کبھی نہیں لیتے'). Repair: add 'کبھی' at the two sites for consistent modal force.

REGISTER A4 / gender-agreement errors: 'طلبہ ... جیتی ہیں' (i18n/ur/.../index.mdx:32; طلبہ takes masculine plural: 'جیتتے ہیں'); 'آپ یہ کر سکنے گیں' (index.mdx:40; non-standard construction, should be 'کر سکیں گے/گیں'); 'ایک استاد ... ملے گی' (topic-03.mdx:60; استاد is masculine: 'ملے گا'); 'کٹی ہوئی محور' (index.mdx:58, topic-02.mdx:45; محور is masculine: 'کٹا ہوا محور', though the plural 'محوریں' at topic-02.mdx:3 is defensible).

SEMANTICS A5 / wrong word 'ہمسر' (peer/equal). EN: 'invite the class's own [situations] before revealing each worked example' (docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:33). UR: 'کلاس سے ان کے اپنے ہمسر مانگیں' (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:31-32) reads 'ask the class for their own peers'. Repair: 'کلاس سے ان کی اپنی صورتحالیں/مثالیں مانگیں'.

REGISTER A6 / non-standard 'کلاس کے کوشنے سے پہلے'. EN: 'Say this aloud before the class attempts it' (docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:73). UR (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:71) uses 'کوشنے', which is not a standard Urdu inflection. Repair: 'کلاس کی کوشش سے پہلے'.

RTL/COMPLETENESS A7 / fig-U6-1 alt-text order divergence. EN alt: 'income, fixed costs, variable costs, savings, review' (docs/.../topic-01.mdx:25) orders savings after variable costs, but the rendered EN SVG (static/img/figures/gqur-300/unit-06/fig-U6-1.svg) boxes are 1 Income, 2 Fixed, 3 Savings, 4 Variable, 5 Review. The UR alt (i18n/ur/.../topic-01.mdx:25 'آمدنی، مقررہ اخراجات، بچت، بدلنے والے اخراجات، جائزہ') matches the actual figure, not the EN alt. Same disagreement the G3 advisory noted for the manifest prompt (its F1). Repair on the English side: align the EN alt (and manifest prompt) to the rendered figure; the Urdu alt then matches both.

COMPLETENESS A8 / harmless alt and description additions, documented for parity: fig-U6-2 UR alt names the four table terms (منافع، نقصان، سودِ سادہ، بجٹ) which the EN alt does not (i18n/ur/.../topic-01.mdx:56 vs docs/.../topic-01.mdx:58; matches the figure content); fig-U6-5 UR alt and .ur.svg desc add 'یونٹ 1' to 'the four-step strategy' (i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:26 vs docs/.../topic-03.mdx:26); teacher-notes UR description adds the advertisement audit to the activity list (i18n/ur/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:3 vs docs/.../unit-teacher-notes.mdx:3; the EN body does cover it). No action required unless strict alt parity is wanted.

TERMINOLOGY A9 / concept-graph Urdu labels (specs/content/gqur-300/concepts/unit-06.md, 11 authored labels flagged for G5 review). 9 of 11 confirmed faithful to the unit's prose and figures (آمدنی منافع نہیں ہوتی; منافع اور نقصان کا فیصد لاگت کے حساب سے; سودِ سادہ: اصل ضرب شرح ضرب مدت; بجٹ کی ترتیب: بچت خرچ سے پہلے; چار قائل کرنے والے ہتھکنڈے; درست حساب بھی دھوکہ دے سکتا ہے; فیصلے کا چکر: سوال، شواہد، اختیارات، مفاد و نقصان; چھوٹی بنیاد پر فیصد ڈگمگاتے ہیں; اشاریے ایک سوال کا جواب دیتے، دوسرا چھپاتے ہیں). Two need repair: CON:GQUR-300-6-6 'قسط سے چھپے ہوئے شرح کو دوبارہ بنانا' should be 'چھپی ہوئی شرح' (feminine agreement), and CON:GQUR-300-6-11 uses 'فیصلہ کن' where the prose consistently says 'فیصلہ کرنے والا' and drops 'never' (EN: 'Data informs the decision, never replaces the decider'). Also note 'ہتھکنڈے' (tricks) carries a negative connotation the neutral EN 'moves' does not; defensible in context but worth an owner look. Recommend the owner promote the confirmed labels into specs/content/terminology.csv; the reviewer has not edited the bank.

SEMANTICS/REGISTER A10 / minor drifts, each with paired locators: 'the quietest one' rendered 'سب سے نرم' (softest) at i18n/ur/.../index.mdx:35 vs docs/.../index.mdx:25; 'hover or tap them' weakened to 'ان پر جائیں' at i18n/ur/.../index.mdx:69 vs docs/.../index.mdx:62; 'ingredients' rendered 'سامان/سازوسامان' (goods/equipment) at i18n/ur/.../topic-01.mdx:28,101 vs docs/.../topic-01.mdx:28,108 (اجناس/خام مال would be precise); 'dentists' rendered 'ڈاکٹر' (doctors) at i18n/ur/.../topic-02.mdx:27-30, fig-U6-4.ur.svg and unit-assessment.mdx:105 vs docs/.../topic-02.mdx:27 and unit-assessment.mdx:110; RRQ-10's 'کون سا مرحلہ کس میں بڑا ہوا' is a garbled relative construction (i18n/ur/.../unit-assessment.mdx:113-114 vs docs/.../unit-assessment.mdx:118-119; the model answer disambiguates); 'all persuade most when the comparison is chosen by the persuader' has awkward word order at i18n/ur/.../topic-02.mdx:56-57; 'incomparable goods' uses the literary plural 'بھلوں' at i18n/ur/.../topic-03.mdx:45,98.

PROCESS A11 / render-inspection channel limitation. This session's image-display channel returned no readable visual content for the saved PNG and JPEG renders (including small crops), the same limitation the G3 run001 recorded as its PR2.
